sentences.en: He watches for an opportunity to intrigue against his rival.
sentences.zh: 他寻找机会对付他的竞争对手。

sentences.en: The employees were intrigued by the odd behavior of their boss.
sentences.zh: 员工们被老板古怪的行为所吸引。

sentences.en: She doesn't have to say a word to make me intrigued.
sentences.zh: 她一句话都不用说就能让我感兴趣。

senses.zh: 密谋策划, 阴谋 - 阴谋, 诡计
